post.description:
Creates an attendance record for a student on a date, or updates the existing record if one already exists (teachers often correct same-day mistakes). The record is stored under the student’s current section (denormalized) and notes from an earlier mark are preserved when not provided.

🔒 Requires the school_admin or staff role — parents and students cannot mark attendance.

post.description:
Uploads a file and records its metadata in the tenant schema.

📎 Allowed types: application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp.
📦 Maximum size: 10485760 bytes (10 MB) — enforced both at the interceptor level and in the service.

In mock mode (FILES_MOCK_MODE=true), the R2 upload is skipped and only the metadata row is created.

requestBody.description:
The file to upload (multipart/form-data field "file").

Allowed MIME types: application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp. Maximum size: 10485760 bytes (10 MB).

400.description: Validation failed — file too large (>10 MB) or disallowed MIME type

413.description: Payload too large — exceeded the interceptor file size limit

post.summary: Upload a file to Cloudflare R2

get.description: Looks up the file record and returns a presigned URL valid for 15 minutes. The URL is generated on demand rather than being permanently public. The response does not redirect or stream the file itself.

200.description: Presigned download URL (expires in 15 minutes) with file metadata

get.summary: Get a time-limited presigned download URL

delete.description: Removes both the Cloudflare R2 object and the metadata row. In mock mode, only the metadata row is removed.

post.description:
Internal-only test endpoint. NOT tenant-scoped: it lives in the public/application scope because notification credentials are application-level, not per-school — so no X-Tenant-ID header or TenantGuard is required. A valid JWT is still required (JwtAuthGuard) so the endpoint is not fully public.

Currently in mock mode: nothing is actually sent. The service logs what would be sent and returns a mock success response, letting us verify the wiring end-to-end before real provider credentials exist.

Public route — NOT protected by JwtAuthGuard or TenantGuard; no Bearer token required.

Note: TenantMiddleware still resolves the tenant context from the X-Tenant-ID header (or subdomain) so login is scoped to a specific tenant. Returns a JWT access token to use as the Bearer token on protected endpoints.
